newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STOCK MARKET GIVES OTC SHAREHOLDER LIST.
newsitem.headline: STOCK MARKET GIVES OTC SHAREHOLDER LIST.

text.p: The Tallinn stock exchange on Friday gave details of the major shareholders in six companies listed on the over the counter free market of the bourse.
The largest shareholder in the EMV construction company is Bank of Bermuda clients, which have 15 percent, and the Baltic Investment Fund with 10.78 percent.
Kalev confectionary's major shareholder is K-Haldus with 25.77 percent followed by Talinvest's client account with 19.01 percent and Uhispank's repo account with 10.95 percent.
Diversified industrialist Norma has Norma Group as it biggest shareholder with a 66.74 percent stake.
Saku biggest stakeholder is Baltic Beverages, which controls 75.01 percent of what is the largest brewery.
E-Investeering Group has the controlling 52.93 percent stake in Tallinna Kaubamaja .
Recently listed clothing manufacturer Klementi's largest shareholder is Baltic Community Partners Estonia which has a 11.83 percent stake.
For a complete list of stake holders over five percent see the Tallinn Stock Exchange web site on www.tse.ee/news/632.txt.
